title: Self-Organising Digital Circuits
abstract: arXiv:2608.02606v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Fault tolerance in classical computing has traditionally relied on static strategies like hardware redundancy and error-correcting codes. Biological systems, in contrast, exhibit adaptive plasticity, maintaining function through dynamic re-organisation around damage. Inspired by this principle, we introduce Self-Organising Digital Circuits, framing functional logic generation and maintenance as a meta-learning problem on graphs. Our architecture employs a topology-masked Transformer that configures the Lookup Tables (LUT) of a circuit's Boolean gates. Extending the pattern-generation paradigm of Neural Cellular Automata (NCA), it navigates the degenerate Boolean search space to satisfy a computational task, rather than regenerating a fixed target state. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.02606v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：经典计算中的容错传统上依赖于静态策略，如硬件冗余和纠错码。相比之下，生物系统表现出适应性可塑性，通过围绕损伤的动态重组来维持功能。受这一原理启发，我们引入了自组织数字电路，将功能逻辑生成与维护构建为图上的元学习问题。我们的架构采用一种拓扑掩蔽的Transformer来配置电路布尔门的查找表（LUT）。它扩展了神经细胞自动机（NCA）的模式生成范式，在退化的布尔搜索空间中导航以满足计算任务，而非重新生成固定的目标状态。我们证明，它可以从零开始自组装功能电路，并围绕永久性、前所未见的硬件故障快速重新路由逻辑。对于软错误，该策略也能有效应对。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于拓扑掩蔽Transformer的自组织数字电路方法，通过元学习在退化布尔空间中自组装电路并动态重组逻辑，以应对硬件故障和软错误。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces self-organising digital circuits using a topology-masked Transformer, which meta-learns to assemble functional circuits from scratch and dynamically reroute logic around hardware faults and soft errors.
